title: Independence, MO — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Independence, MO: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Independence is a city in MO with a population of 117,000. Harry Truman’s hometown with the Truman Library and a historic square. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees.
